title: Figaro Commerce Schema v1
description: Off-chain schema definition for the figaro-commerce-v1 agreement section schema. Defines the standard basket-of-goods section used in Figaro bilateral agreement manifests. Describes what goods or services are covered by the bonded commitment.

overview.description: figaro-commerce-v1 is an agreement section schema, not a lifecycle attestation schema. It describes the structure of the 'data' field in an AgreementSection with schema key 'figaro-commerce-v1'. This section is included at commitment-time in the bilateral agreement manifest and is co-signed by both parties.
overview.agreementRole: Specifies what the commitment covers: a basket of line items, the payment amount, and the token currency. The agreementHash that both parties sign is the keccak256 of the canonical JSON of the full Agreement, which includes this section.
overview.lifecycleRelation: This schema does not define attestation stages. It is not submitted to AttestationCoordinator. It defines the content of the agreement that drives the bonded commitment. Attestation stages for the fulfilment process are defined in figaro-merchant-process-v1 and figaro-courier-process-v1.

sectionDataFormat.description: The 'data' field of an AgreementSection with schema key 'figaro-commerce-v1' must conform to this structure.

currency.description: ERC-20 token contract address used for payment and bonding. Must match the currency field of the on-chain Commitment struct.

payment.description: Payment amount in the token's smallest unit (wei for 18-decimal tokens). String to avoid float precision loss. Must match the payment field of the on-chain Commitment struct.

lineItems.description: Ordered list of goods or services covered by this commitment. May be empty for bulk-value commitments where item-level detail is not required.

itemId.description: Identifier from the seller's catalogue. Opaque to the protocol — interpreted by the assembly.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the item at time of order. Stored for audit purposes — not authoritative after catalogue updates.

quantity.description: Number of units ordered. Must be a positive integer.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in the token's smallest unit, at the time the agreement was formed. String to avoid float precision loss.

canonicalizationNote.description: The agreement section data is included in the canonical JSON of the Agreement, which is hashed to produce the agreementHash. All object keys are sorted recursively, and arrays preserve insertion order. The currency, payment, and lineItems fields must be serialized exactly as described — floating point representations of payment or unitPrice will produce a different hash.
canonicalizationNote.sortingRule: Keys sorted lexicographically at every nesting level. lineItems array preserves the order in which items were added to the cart.
canonicalizationNote.hashBinding: agreementHash = keccak256(UTF-8 bytes of canonical JSON of Agreement). Implemented in frontend/lib/core/agreementManifest.ts computeAgreementHash().

processTreeBinding.description: A commerce section binds to a single order node in the process. Sub-orders (e.g., delivery sub-orders) may carry their own commerce section describing the delivery service terms, distinct from the root order's goods section.
processTreeBinding.rootOrderRole: The commerce section of the root order describes the primary goods or services transaction (buyer ↔ merchant — e.g., restaurant, retailer, service-provider).
processTreeBinding.subOrderRole: A delivery sub-order may carry a minimal commerce section describing the delivery fee and service terms (buyer ↔ courier — e.g., driver, cyclist, walker, drone), if required by the assembly.
